from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/polymer_probe.py').read_text(); p=p.replace('"""Calibrate the load cells and fit the sub-yield two-branch creep law."""','"""Calibrate load cells and predict preloaded two-mode coupon creep."""'); p += '''def _drift(aligned, weights, rate_design, split):
    feature = weights[2] + aligned @ weights[3:]
    measured = np.asarray(split['instant_rate_obs']) - rate_design[:, :2] @ weights[:2]
    missing = np.any(~np.isfinite(split['coupon_features_raw']), axis=1)
    return np.where(missing & np.isfinite(measured), measured, feature)


def _crossing(times, strain0, predicted, critical):
    grid = np.r_[0., times]
    y = np.column_stack((strain0, predicted))
    hit = y >= critical[:, None]
    j = np.argmax(hit, axis=1)
    out = np.full(len(y), grid[-1])
    out[hit[:, 0]] = 0.
    rows = np.flatnonzero(j > 0)
    k = j[rows]
    left = y[rows, k-1]
    fraction = (critical[rows] - left) / (y[rows, k] - left)
    out[rows] = grid[k-1] + fraction * (grid[k] - grid[k-1])
    return out


def solve_alpha_w04_batch_01(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    train, test = dataset['train'], dataset['test']
    dt, times = np.asarray(dataset['past_dt']), np.asarray(dataset['eval_times'])
    affine = _calibrate(dataset['calibration_load_cells'])
    x, xt = _align(train, test)
    hist, hold = _stress(train, affine)
    ht, st = _stress(test, affine)
    y = train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None]
    complete = np.all(np.isfinite(train['coupon_features_raw']), axis=1)
    taus, weights = _fit(dt, times, hist[complete], hold[complete], x[complete],
                         y[complete], train['instant_rate_obs'][complete],
                         train['initial_memory_states'][complete])
    curves, rate = _design(taus, dt, times, ht, st, xt, test['initial_memory_states'])
    strain0 = np.asarray(test['strain_0'])
    predicted = (strain0[:, None] + curves[:, :, :2] @ weights[:2]
                 + _drift(xt, weights, rate, test)[:, None] * times)
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'predicted_strain': predicted,
            'secant_compliance': (predicted[:, -1] - strain0) / np.maximum(np.abs(st), 0.5),
            'hazard_crossing_times': _crossing(times, strain0, predicted,
                                               np.asarray(test['critical_strain']))}
'''; Path('/holdout_task/alpha_w04_batch_01_solver.py').write_text(p)
